title: microsorum schumannianum
intro: Microsorum schumannianum, commonly known as the Ruffled Mangrove Fern, is a type of tropical fern native to the coastal regions of Southeast Asia. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum schumannianum include its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, making it a promising candidate for the development of antimicrobial drugs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
